## What you did
- Moved the dashboard CSV export to a background job: `POST /export` returns 202, the job streams rows (flat memory, 230k rows in 41s) to the exports bucket and emails a signed link valid 24h; the front now shows "Export requested — we'll email you" instead of spinning forever. [2]
- Polished the v2 widget card: header 56→40px on design tokens, dark-mode border fixed, retention tooltip shows "Week of Nov 2" instead of raw cohort keys, categorical palette for the 8 cohorts, and a skeleton so the chart no longer jumps (CLS 0.21→0.02). [1]

## What changed
- Daniel approved the export PR: "streaming + 202 looks right, merge when CI is green." [5]
- Maya: ship v2 behind the flag, but keep @chartkit/react until v1 is gone — she doesn't want two migrations at once. [7]
- Dependabot opened #429, bumping @chartkit/react 4.2.0 → 5.0.0 (new tooltip API, dropped legacy browser support). [4]
- Sentry picked up the RetentionChart tooltip crash on staging (#432, KESTREL-WEB-3F1). [8]

## What is still open
- Priya's blocker for Thursday: the CSV export is missing from the v2 widget menu, and both Orbitly and Zest need it — bring it back on top of the new background export. Flag for Orbitly Thursday 19/11, staging solid by Wednesday 18/11, i.e. today. [10][3]
- Merge the export PR once CI is green, and give Rachel an ETA for Zest, whose Monday ops review depends on that export (their dashboard has ~230k rows). [5][9][6]
- Fix the RetentionChart tooltip crash on empty cohorts (guard `point?.label`, show "No data yet", add a test) — 37 events, 4 users on staging. [8][1]
